author: XTREMPANDA
body:
Hihi you may or may not know me, for the good or the bad reasons, but anyway, Hello .o/

So I first joined this server a while back in the beginning of Mczone, then I only really got back into Avicus ~3 months ago. In those months I've enjoyed Avicus, but I also thought it could be a lot better, like everything, because something perfect isn't perfect. (Bacon is perfect thought) . Also be aware that I may suggest stuff that already exist or already been suggested in the past.

Also those suggestions are personal, I do not mean to offend anyone or thrash on Avicus, those are suggestions I think would make the server better and more enjoyable.

Anyway let's get into:

Panda's suggestions for a better Avicus \(0)/

Those suggestions are for, staff, players, map makers and pandas lovers.

Server:

CTH:
  • Lower the minimum player cap (4 would be the best in my opinion) due to the fact that there is a few players playing and the few time I tried to play there was never enough players.
  • Be able to join during game. There is already not a lot of people playing, at least let them join during a game, I do not think it can affect in anyway the gameplay. (Actually I think you are not able to join during a game, I might be wrong)
  • Raise the point countdown. I personally think that the countdown should start a few more seconds, so it let the players to actually prepare and fight for the points.
  • I would personally like to see CTH completely redone, different gameplay, but with the same goal. I don't want to get into this right now though.
Nexus:
  • Nerf or get rid of Barbarian. The kit barbarian is way to overpowered and give a total unfair advantage to anyone not having it, it can even force the ones not having it to just change server. I would recommend to keep it, but the armor should be nerfed (just a chestplate and a helmet?).
  • Get rid of most long grasses in maps. Let's be honest, hitting grass over and over probably one of the most annoying thing, for the pleasure of everyone, I would recommend getting rid of most of the grass (ex: venemous, the arc...) or at least making it breakable would be good.
  • Make the maps less laggy. It may sounds weird, but a few maps out there are laggy and with a really PVP oriented gamemode it really sucks. And the lag can be reduced by removing unneeded blocks (fences, glowstone, lava, trapdoors, torches, and other unneeded structure outside of the map). With this PVP oriented gamemode good aesthetics is not what we need the most.
  • Displaying high killing spree in chat (for everyone). Having something that tells everyone if someone is on a killing spree would be really nice. Yes it would create targeting, but this is why it would be fun and challenging for someone to keep his killing spree. ( Display at 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50)
  • Actually punish spawn killing / Kill farming (or at least make the rule clear) . We can't talk about Quintus without talking about spawn killing and such. Now people are smart, they don't actually kill in spawn, but they go in front of it and wait for the people (nowhere else to go) and kill them, I do think it should be punishable if: they are avoiding gameplay (objectives) and killing a new spawner if he is just trying to go out of his spawn. But for sure, if a new spawner try to kill the kill farmer, it shouldn't be considered spawnkilling because the guy is trying to save himself. Be sure to check mspotter about this issue: http://avicus.net/forums/0c5e7bf15 
The Walls:
  • Add a sound when someone die. Would be a nice feature.
Elimination:
I got to play this once and if I remember correctly it was just plain survival games.
  • Maybe make the gamemode special, with a twist or something. Here's a super cool idea by MarkColtsfan to add a twist to Emlimination: http://avicus.net/forums/b7b979042
Nebula:
  • Give XP for getting a monument depending the map. Any monuments give you 7 XP. Raising that amount would make players play more for the actual goal. Also some monuments are harder or maps have more than one monument. I would recommend giving at least 10 XP for monuments and for some 20 or even 25.
  • Fixing spawn protection. In some maps you need to go through the spawn to go to monuments, to get armor or even just to defend. The problem is that some maps also protect have a spawn protection -y to y, Not allowing to place blocks in places where you should totally be able to, and even making defenders unkillable. 
  • Make enchanting tables unbreakable. Pretty self explanatory. 
  • Do not create huge armor differences. If there is diamond in a map, please, make us spawn with more than just a leather helmet.
Help the noobs!
As a beginner it is hard to fully understand how Avicus works and learn all his features. I would recommend making those toggleable.
  • Adding point streak notification. When a player get 10 points a notification could appear telling him something that would look like: "Hey it looks that you just hit 10 points! Don't forget to visit the shop by right clicking your nether star."
  • Tell the objective at the beginning of matches. By exemple, when a game starts: "Venemous: Destroy all 3 obsidian monuments located in the enemy side to win the game! Good luck!"
  • A lots more could be done ^_^
Website:
I heard it was being worked on but anyway here's some features that are not needed but would be really helpful.
  • Adding tabs for additional pages. Pages like staff, rules and more are currently situated in the Support tab, I think it would be better if they would also be situated in the general website, meaning we would not need to go to support to go to those pages. Exemple: At the left of the Youtube logo or even adding a little arrow at Support, like Leaderboard.
  • Adding a way to easily appeal and or get information about punishments. Right now the only way to actually appeal or get information about your own punishment is by directly getting in touch with a staff member, which can be really hard. I would recommend a feature that would allow you to easily comment punishments.
  • Alerts. Like the old website. I heard it was being worked on but still. So ye I think it would be great to receive some kind of website notification when people: add you as friend, reply to you on the forum and reply to your thread.
  • Adding a toggleable comment section on profiles. What I mean by that is a way where people can comment on eachothers profile (politely). By exemple: "Hey it was a nice fight today, we should play sometimes together!" And then you could reply: Yes indeed it was! I'll add you as friend we could defend some times!"  Also people could link a video they made and where we can see the guy. I think it would be a nice feature to add. 
  • Adding staff description. I think it would be nice to add a little description for the roles of staff in the avicus.net/staff page, because personally Managers manages, manage what exactly? This is not needed since knowing that will not really change anything, but it's always great for the regular members to know how the server runs.
General:
  • Host official and unofficial events: Events keep the player to play and make other to start playing. Ex: Tournaments, giveaway, map testing, TeamSpeak party, etc.
  • Be able to message anyone. (As dodgerXyz suggested) Right now you can only message your friends, but some times, you want to talk privately to a staff member or even another player. But What I would add to that is that it should also be toggleable or a fast way to /ignore.
  • Ignoring other players. You should be able to ignore players by just going on their profile and clicking a butting "ignore/block" That would make them unable to reply to you on the forum, in game message you or comment on your profile.
  • Making TeamSpeak more popular. This may be a harder one, but currently every time I go on TS there is no one and if there is people they are in privates staff/donor rooms. Maybe try to popularize the TS by making threads about having TS events. I am out of idea for this one, but having a popular teamspeak server would be great because TeamSpeak keep the players from knowing eachother, playing, starting to play, having fun, learning, etc.
  • If someone disconnect, predict his death. Meaning that if someone disconnect he just dies, and if he was fighting, the last player hitting him gets the credit for the kill. With that, combat logging could be legal and it would stop a lot of hate about Combat logging and such
Map making:
  • Add a module that let you decide the XP given for certain objectives.
Moderators:
  • Do not multiple bans. When punishing someone, look at their past punishments before or at least right after dealing the punishments. Exemple: http://gyazo.com/e47b81b3a986bbf36edb636346352813  In this picture we can think that I trolled three times, but in reality I only trolled once, but the moderators dealt 3 punishments for odd reasons. This is what I call multiple bans, at least when doing it, remove the unnecessary ones.
  • Make hackusating punishable.
  • When seing someone doing something illegal warn in global chat. Warning in global chat is good before dealing punishments because it can stop the ones doing in doing it but also will make others to think before doing that same thing.
  • Do not make fun of punished players. I've started to see this a lot lately, before banning players, some moderators make fun of them. They usually a bad joke or some bad puns and then PUNish them (ha.. :3). Anyway, it really just looks unprofessional and it is unnecessary.
  • If someone disconnect, predict his death. Meaning that if someone disconnect he just dies, and if he was fighting, the last player hitting him gets the credit for the kill. With that, combat logging could be legal and it would stop a lot of hate about Combat logging and such
  • Good luck and thanks for your work! Man you guys are really just a few, good job in the work you are actually doing and good luck in the future!
Community: 
  • Try to be nice? This might sounds weird, but as someone considered "not from Avicus" I've been getting really hated since the first day I got back into Avicus. So I have something to ask to the community, do you want to stay the same and not accept others? Because that's how it is looking like right now. Exemple, today I was playing avicus as usual and after 30 seconds, someone told me to go back to OCN, something I though was first a joke ended up as a bunch of people supporting him and me getting hated for no reason. I personally do not care, but it is not making me want to stay here. Anyway I'm not saying everybody is like that, but way too many are and it is not really welcoming to new comers.
Map makers:
  • Think about the gameplay! Some maps looks good but lack of gameplay.
  • Use your originality! Maps are fun when they are original, a lot of maps ut there are really similar and have the same gameplay (monuments, void, spawn, void, spawn, void, monuments) and are even really similar in the layouts
Other staff members:
Keep doing your things! ^_^ Here's free cookies: o o ø O 0 o ø


I think this is it, I will add some more later, if yourself you have suggestions (I'll try to add a section for it) or want to comment and share your opinions about any of the above  suggestions feel free! If you just want to ask me something or tell me hi, also feel free! Feel free to also add me on Skype for more! 

Thank you for reading and I hope any of this will help ^_^

  • Alerts. Like the old website. I heard it was being worked on but still. So ye I think it would be great to receive some kind of website notification when people: add you as friend, reply to you on the forum and reply to your thread.
  • Adding a toggleable comment section on profiles. What I mean by that is a way where people can comment on eachothers profile (politely). By exemple: "Hey it was a nice fight today, we should play sometimes together!" And then you could reply: Yes indeed it was! I'll add you as friend we could defend some times!"  Also people could link a video they made and where we can see the guy. I think it would be a nice feature to add. 
  • Ignoring other players. You should be able to ignore players by just going on their profile and clicking a butting "ignore/block" That would make them unable to reply to you on the forum, in game message you or comment on your profile.

replies.author: XTREMPANDA
replies.body:
Alright I was busy during the past months, but I got a bit more ideas! ^_^ Also I'm glad they made hackusations punishable, thanks! :D

Let's get right into it:
Adding:
  • Actually punish spawn killing / Kill farming (or at least make the rule clear) . We can't talk about Quintus without talking about spawn killing and such. Now people are smart, they don't actually kill in spawn, but they go in front of it and wait for the people (nowhere else to go) and kill them, I do think it should be punishable if: they are avoiding gameplay (objectives) and killing a new spawner if he is just trying to go out of his spawn. But for sure, if a new spawner try to kill the kill farmer, it shouldn't be considered spawnkilling because the guy is trying to save himself.
  • Do not make fun of punished players. I've started to see this a lot lately, before banning players, some moderators make fun of them. They usually a bad joke or some bad puns and then PUNish them (ha.. :3). Anyway, it really just looks unprofessional and it is unnecessary.
  • Try to be nice? This might sounds weird, but as someone considered "not from Avicus" I've been getting really hated since the first day I got back into Avicus. So I have something to ask to the community, do you want to stay the same and not accept others? Because that's how it is looking like right now. Exemple, today I was playing avicus as usual and after 30 seconds, someone told me to go back to OCN, something I though was first a joke ended up as a bunch of people supporting him and me getting hated for no reason. I personally do not care, but it is not making me want to stay here. Anyway I'm not saying everybody is like that, but way too many are and it is not really welcoming to new comers.
  • If someone disconnect, predict his death. Meaning that if someone disconnect he just dies, and if he was fighting, the last player hitting him gets the credit for the kill. With that, combat logging could be legal and it would stop a lot of hate about Combat logging and such
Also in reply to enderspirit14: Yee! It does sound like an awesome idea, but right now I do not think there is enough active players, but maybe later when the servers are more stable with a regular community!
